title: Keeps Your Beer Cold and Your Friends Amused
text:
Keeps Your Beer Cold and Your Friends Amused. Keeping your beer chilled and ready to drink is important. Finding a way to accomplish this during a football themed party is made easy and fun with the Football Inflatable Cooler from Big Mouth, Inc.

Big Mouth manufactures many novelty items related to football and this cooler is one of a handful designed to keep items cold during a tailgate or other party. The cooler is easy to store because it comes in a small box and has to be inflated to use. I found that it does take a good effort to get it blown up and ready to use and the reason is because the blow hole has a tight seal that, even when you squeeze, doesn’t let in much breath. On the positive side, that means it also doesn’t lose air when you let go. The cooler’s interior air space volume isn’t very big but again, it is an exercise in lung power to get it inflated completely and ready for use.

The interior section of this cooler, where the beer is chilled, isn’t very large compared to the rest of the cooler, but it is big enough to hold roughly 12 bottles or cans of beer without any problem. It’s deep enough that you can stand the bottles upright and still cover them with enough ice to keep them chilled. You could possibly squeeze in more bottle or cans, but best to leave some space for the ice and purchase a second cooler if you anticipate having a large number of cans or bottles in need of chilling.

My greatest issue with this novelty item is its flimsiness. There is no solid backing and that means you need to be very careful if you use it indoors. Once the ice starts to melt and your cans/bottles are floating in slush, it will be difficult to transport it to the nearest sink or outdoors to dump. You could very easily spill the water and ice everywhere, making a big mess. This is why I recommend using it outdoors for the most part. With it safely outside, this worry is eliminated.

One other issue I have with a cooler like this is that it could get punctured and therefore may have a short usable life. The manufacturer does include a patch kit so you can repair a problem like this without too much difficulty. Still, if you’re the type who likes to play rough with your cooler, then a product like this may not last very long.

Beer is an important part of any football game experience and with the Football Inflatable Cooler, you can enjoy your beer and amuse your friends with your cool beer storage device made with football in mind. The fact that this is inflatable and plastic means it does have its share of pros and cons, but as long as you’re careful, you should find this a fun addition to your next tailgate experience.

Note: I received this product complimentary in exchange for an unbiased review, but I was not compensated in any way.
